note: This is a FORWARD erratum. The original V0 evidence and verdicts are untouched; the corrected claims are recorded here and in the V0S verdicts.
preservedAccomplishments: real DSH cold reading through the first-party persistence and session-query packages, with no host, no activation and no model call
real non-model asynchronous Work inspection through the product delegation and worker-port stack
T0 Project Evolution reuse inside one read-only Handoff Preview
a read-only Handoff Preview with structural status separation and no continuation authority

correctedClaims.v0Claim: arbitrary caller-selected Sessions were adequately Attempt-scoped (BOUND_LOCAL_ONLY, events presented as the attempt's)
correctedClaims.correction: a caller's SessionId is SESSION_CLAIMED_UNVERIFIED and its events are NOT_ADMITTED_TO_ATTEMPT; no producer establishes Attempt ownership in this deployment

correctedClaims.v0Claim: two-Attempt isolation included all malicious wrong-source substitutions
correctedClaims.correction: V0 covered a wrong SessionId claim and a header mismatch, but accepted a wrong-attempt HostRecord and did not check host-record identity at all; HOST_RECORD_CONFLICT now refuses it

correctedClaims.v0Claim: Session readability was sufficient for complete execution attribution
correctedClaims.correction: readability is one of four separate attribution dimensions; a readable unrelated Session yields PARTIAL, never COMPLETE

correctedClaims.v0Claim: all returned DSH recovery events were independently persisted
correctedClaims.correction: readColdSessionLog appends interruptedTurnClosers; each event is now PERSISTED_DSH_EVENT or SYNTHETIC_RECOVERY_EVENT, or DURABILITY_UNRESOLVED when the seam cannot prove the boundary

correctedClaims.v0Claim: the reader's bounded page implied bounded cost, and an unusable cursor could be coerced
correctedClaims.correction: RETURN_PAGE_BOUNDED is reported separately from DISK_IO_PAGE_BOUNDED; negative, fractional and excessive cursors are refused as INVALID_REQUEST

correctedClaims.v0Claim: Work nodes belonging to the Attempt could be located by a display label
correctedClaims.correction: selection uses the exact canonical Work event_id identity set and requires ESTABLISHED_BY_OWNER_REFERENCE with matching edge evidence

notCorrected: the Attempt→DSH Session binding remains absent: no producer reports the DSH SessionId to the Palimpsest Host (see dsh-identity-producer-feasibility.json)
the G1-B host-origin trust limitation is unchanged and remains stated on every Preview
